facts.text: The resort is set amid 92 acres of vineyards in Santa Rosa, California.
facts.excerpt: Set amidst 92 acres of vineyards in Santa Rosa, California, Vinarosa Resort & Spa Resort is your gateway to adventure.

facts.text: Santa Rosa is considered the heart of Sonoma County due to its central location.
facts.excerpt: Considered the heart of Sonoma County due to its central location

facts.text: Some of the most renowned Pinot Noir and Chardonnay grapes are grown in the region.
facts.excerpt: some of the most renowned Pinot Noir and Chardonnay grapes are grown

facts.text: Guests can hike and bike amid the redwood forests of the Russian River Valley, picnic on the Sonoma Coast, or explore Sonoma County's wineries and culinary destinations.
facts.excerpt: Hike and bike amidst the redwood forests of the Russian River Valley, picnic on the Sonoma Coast, or explore Sonoma County’s famous wineries and culinary destinations.

facts.text: The resort is 60 miles north of San Francisco.
facts.excerpt: We’re just 60 miles north of San Francisco

facts.text: The resort is a 10-minute drive from Charles M. Schulz-Sonoma County Airport (STS).
facts.excerpt: a 10-minute drive from Charles M. Schulz-Sonoma County Airport (STS)

facts.text: The resort offers a parking valet and access to luxury transportation services.
facts.excerpt: as well as a parking valet and access to luxury transportation services

facts.text: Dining options include John Ash and The Front Room.
The resort takes spa reservations alongside restaurant reservations.
The resort's address is 4350 Barnes Road, Santa Rosa, CA 95403.
The resort describes itself as a gateway to adventure.
facts.excerpt: Vinarosa Resort & Spa Resort is your gateway to adventure.
